description: This source file defines a React functional component 'BookingModal' that manages the booking process in a smart parking reservation system. It handles user interactions for confirming a parking slot booking, communicates with an API, and displays a QR code upon successful booking.

methods.name: confirm
methods.description: Asynchronous function that initiates a booking request to the backend API. It manages loading state, handles fallback creation of a booking object if API call fails, and updates the component state with the booking data.
